event_name: Renault Sport Formula One Team Document 28 Date 22 July 2018 Time 16:50 2018 GERMAN GRAND PRIX 19 - 22 July 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 55 overtook car 9 under the Safety Car.
incident_time: Penalty. (2 penalty points awarded, 2 penalty points for the 12 month period).
offence: Breach of Article 39.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence that clearly showed that car 55 overtook car 9 under the Safety Car.
rules_referenced: Article 39.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
